applies_to: live2d_bust_up only; body is actual face/neck illustration; other assets align to existing face-led body without redraw
design_basis: Artist-selected starting proportions for anime VTuber face-first portrait. Not a statistically measured industry average, mandatory Live2D specification, or substitute for user character reference.

definitions.H: Scalp crown to chin height, excludes hair; used only in bust-up body composition.
definitions.F: Horizontal skin face width between temples at the eye line; excludes ears and hair.
definitions.E: One eye aperture outline horizontal span, excludes decorative extended eyelash tips.

body_defaults.frame_height_over_H: 1.65–1.95H (unclothed scalp crown to chin measure; choose by actual portrait readability)
body_defaults.head_silhouette_in_frame: scalp crown to chin ~52–61% of image height; hair absent in BODY kit, so no fictitious hair mass
body_defaults.hair_equipped_preview: with separate user hair layer, combined head/hair may take roughly 58–70% of frame but NEVER paint that hair in BODY ZIP
body_defaults.eyewidth_over_F: 23–29% optional starting range for this anime-style bust-up BODY only
body_defaults.eye_gap_over_E: 0.65–0.95 eye widths, after preserving user reference
body_defaults.visible_iris_width_over_E: 62–80% with intentional upper eyelid partial overlap
body_defaults.eyes_position: prominent in upper face, visually expressive in small live stream preview; not numerically fixed by Cubism
body_defaults.body_cutoff: just below shoulders/upper chest/collarbone region, safety-covered by opaque base; do not show long torso, waist, elbows or hands
body_defaults.look: anime VTuber face first; stylized large upper face, refined tapering chin, small simplified nose, small mouth, clean dark tapering lashes and flat controlled cel shadows, smooth nonphotographic anatomy
body_defaults.exclusions: photo, 3D render, photoreal skin pores, realistic human adult eyes, photo fashion portrait, realistic ribcage/cleavage, small iris, wide photographic shoulders, long visible torso, plain realistic mannequin, crude chibi/vector

short_scope.body: 얼굴 중심 근접 바스트업. H=두피 정수리~턱. 전체 프레임 세로는 약 1.65~1.95H를 시작값으로 하고, 두피~턱이 화면 세로 52~61% 정도로 크게 보이게 한다. 목·어깨·쇄골/윗가슴만 짧게 보이고 허리·긴 몸통·팔꿈치·손은 그리지 않는다. 이 수치는 공식 규격이 아닌 이 프로젝트의 얼굴 중심 미술 시작값이며 사용자 참조가 우선이다.
short_scope.hair: 얼굴 중심 근접 바스트업인 이미 제공된 몸체 원점·스케일만 따른다. 머리/몸통 프레임 비율이나 눈을 새로 설정하지 않고 실제 요청받은 헤어스타일만 제작한다. 얼굴을 가리지 않도록 필요한 앞머리 가닥을 정렬하되 피부·눈을 그리지 않는다.
short_scope.outfit: 얼굴 중심 근접 바스트업 기준 몸체의 짧게 보이는 어깨·목깃·쇄골 아래 부분에만 해당 의상을 정렬한다. 긴 몸판·허리·팔꿈치·하의가 화면에 없는 경우 생성하지 않는다. 얼굴·피부·머리카락을 새로 그리지 않는다.
short_scope.accessory: 얼굴 중심 근접 바스트업 기준 몸체/헤어의 실제 고정부만 참조한다. 요청된 소품 하나만 원점·축척에 정렬하며 몸체 프레임·눈·목·피부를 다시 제작하지 않는다.

body_face: 신체 ZIP 한정: F=정면 관자놀이 사이 얼굴폭(귀·모발 제외), E=눈꺼풀 외곽 눈 한쪽 너비(긴 속눈썹 제외). 큰 애니 VTuber 표정을 위한 선택적 시작값 E/F=23~29%, 양눈 간격/E=0.65~0.95, 보이는 홍채 폭/E=62~80%. 단순히 숫자를 채우는 것이 아니라 큰 상안부·도드라진 홍채/상안검 곡선·섬세한 눈꼬리, 작고 단정한 코/입, 좁고 부드러운 애니 턱, 단순화된 귀·목 그림자가 시각적으로 애니풍이어야 한다. 실사 인물 피부·안와 뼈·광대·콧대·넓은 어깨·긴 몸통을 금지. 숫자는 업계 실측 평균/검수용 강제 조건이 아니고 사용자 설정 외형이 우선.
body_visual_qa: 실제 렌더된 기준 신체 원화와 합성 미리보기에서 머리/얼굴이 상체보다 먼저 보이고 화면 하단의 몸통이 작게 잘리는가? 맨머리 상태에서도 얼굴이 고급 애니풍인지, E/F 23~29%·홍채 62~80% 시작값을 넘어서는 원본 디자인도 존중하는가? 실사형 눈/코/턱/어깨·넓은 가슴 사진같은 음영·단색 속옷 마네킹을 고급 원화로 오판하지 않는가? 밝고 어두운 배경에서 눈/입 이중 표시·목 절단·알파 경계가 없는가? 이미지 자체를 보지 않았으면 합격 선언 금지.
image_prompt_body: Masterpiece 2D hand-drawn Japanese anime VTuber FACE-DOMINANT CLOSE BUST-UP BODY BASE artwork, FRONT VIEW; composition centered on an oversized expressive anime head and face, scalp-to-chin taking approximately 52-61 percent of canvas height, only a short neck, shoulders, collarbone and the very top of safely opaque covered chest visible at the lower edge, absolutely no long torso, no waist and no elbows or hands. Beautiful distinctly ANIME eyes large relative to face width, large multilayer irises and bold tapering upper eyelashes, luminous eye highlights and clean whites; soft anime cheek silhouette tapering toward a smaller chin; tiny stylized nose, small clean mouth, reduced realistic anatomy, smooth controlled cel shading with refined colored inner lineart. Bald/without detachable hair because BODY asset only; no wigs, fashion outfit, jewelry or photo-like texture. Not photorealism, not 3D render, not realistic person, not fashion photography, not realistic small eyes/irises, not human anatomy study, not large torso/shoulder portrait, not a crude mannequin; draw an actual high-end anime VTuber bust-up illustration.

image_prompt_other.hair: Exact same FACE-FIRST close-bust-up reference canvas and head anchor, generate only the user-chosen hair artwork, with believable volume and natural root-to-tip flow, high-end clean anime ink and stylized cel highlights; keep underlying face large and readable but no face/eye/neck/body pixels in exported hair PNG.
image_prompt_other.outfit: Use the supplied FACE-FIRST bust-up body canvas. Only the actual requested garment visible around short shoulders, collar and upper chest; material-accurate anime folds and lining; transparent outfit pixels only, no long torso/waist/skirts unless genuinely visible in reference, no face/eye/skin/hair.
image_prompt_other.accessory: Use the same FACE-FIRST bust-up canvas only for scale, draw exactly one requested attached item, clear at streaming preview size with correct L/R and occlusion, no face/eye/body/hair/clothing regeneration and no extra ornaments.

official_example_policy: The Tsumiki / Izumi Live2D sample image URLs illustrate only general line art and cel finish; their FULL-BODY screenshots must NOT be used as portrait framing, image-to-image composition, facial eye-size measurements, or prompts for a body-focused shot. Keep as plain links rather than prominent inline full-body pictures. A character reference provided by the user controls actual design.
test_contract: All four bust-up ZIPs must have 14 valid MD and face-first camera framing. Only BODY can create/size eyes, face and skin. All 4 should lack old bust-up torso-heavy 1~2H and 2.2~2.8H/40~50% targets. Non-bust-up ZIPs unchanged.
